objects: a set of object vectors O = {o1,...,on} in R^m, considered pairwise
assumptions: which object pairs are actually related is not known in advance and must be inferred
output must be invariant to the order of objects in the input set
guarantees: no formal theorem; permutation invariance asserted as a consequence of summation, not separately derived
18/20 tasks solved on joint bAbI suite
formalism.operation: sum a learned pairwise relation function over every ordered pair of objects, then transform the sum to produce the output

evidence_spans.objects: the input is a set of "objects" O = {o1, o2, ..., on}, oi in R^m is the ith object
evidence_spans.assumptions: RNs must learn to infer the existence and implications of object relations.
evidence_spans.guarantees: Our model achieved state-of-the-art performance on CLEVR at 95.5%, exceeding the best model trained only on the pixel images and questions... and surpassing human performance.
